title: Reproduction Art: Seal
slide_intent: Show where a circular seal should align during reproduction. A reference through its center makes alignment checkable on the production drawing.
strategic_value: NASA can preserve the seal’s proportions and orientation by supplying camera-ready artwork with alignment guidance.
demonstration: A single large seal sits beneath the instructions. Horizontal guide marks outside its circumference establish the alignment reference, with a note to trim them away.
practical_value: Align the seal using the external reference and trim away the guide before reproducing the finished artwork.

content_islands.name: Reproduction note
content_islands.spec: Identify the seal master at the top and allow photographic enlargement or reduction.

content_islands.name: Seal and alignment guide
content_islands.spec: Center the black seal in the lower field. Place short horizontal guide marks to either side and keep the trimming note outside the seal.
